title: Lifestyles Implemented-Survivorship Care Plan In Lymphoma Survivors
official: Lifestyles Implemented-Survivorship Care Plan In Lymphoma Survivors: A Randomized Non-pharmacological Clinical Trial By The Fondazione Italiana Linfomi (FIL)
summary: This is a prospective randomized open-label, multicenter, 2-arm study to assess the role of healthy LifeStyle implemented Survivorship Care Plan (LS-SCP) in modifying the Quality of Life (QoL) in a population of long-term lymphoma survivors (in remission for a minimum 3 years since the last treatment and a maximum of 10 years).
